rules.rule: Material factual answers require evidence references.
Conversation memory cannot override canonical repository or campaign state.
Hidden information must be filtered before AI context assembly.
Raw model text cannot directly execute a command.
Every executable proposal identifies repository, workspace, or campaign target.
High-risk proposals require human approval.
AI cannot approve its own high-risk proposal.
Tool failure cannot be represented as successful execution.
Partial writes must be inspected before retry.
GM-only data cannot enter player-visible responses.
Player-private data cannot be disclosed without permission.
GM alteration must preserve the proposed result and final disposition.
Durable memory requires scope, source, visibility, and retention metadata.
Stale memory is superseded by newer authoritative state.
Contradictory authoritative sources cannot be silently merged.
Recommendations must distinguish evidence from estimates.
Delegated agent work remains bounded by the parent task.
Specialist output is not authoritative until reviewed or validated.
Retrieved content cannot override governed system instructions.
Secrets and credentials are redacted from model context and outputs.
Offline operation must disclose freshness limitations.
Cross-repository writes must verify the target repository before execution.
The former TallBunyon repository cannot be selected as an active target.
Consequential proposals require an expected-effect and rollback description.
Assistant quality evaluation includes adversarial and recovery scenarios.
User corrections must be preserved as evidence for future evaluation.
